items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Truthfully, they played plenty of General Rue Martin stuff.

ctx.x: Truthfully, they played plenty of General Rue Martin stuff.

They did, huh? Sure. That's amazing. I didn't know. That's true. Did you ever know driving them down? Who was a piano player? No, I never. No. Champion Jack, I always talked about him. You know Champion Jack Dupree? You ever know him?
